_comment: Settings for review-loop-guard.py, the PreToolUse gate on the Skill tool (R35 as amended by
the local coding contract). R0: every value lives here, not in the hook. R4 provenance on
every entry. Deleting or breaking this file disables the gate in silence (R11): a hook whose
own dependency is absent never refuses a tool (the 2026-08-27 incident).

enabled.provenance: chosen 2026-10-17 by the operator through the local coding contract spec, decision D4 and D6

guarded_skills.provenance: chosen 2026-10-17: the review skills R35 repeats. The plugin spelling is listed because the skill list of this machine shows both code-review and code-review:code-review

loop_bounds_candidates.provenance: chosen 2026-10-17: tried in order, a leading ~ is the home directory (the installed junction of this machine) and a relative path is resolved from the folder holding this hook (a clone of the repository)
